title: Finite probability distribution
statement: A finite probability distribution on a finite set $\alpha$ assigns a real number $p(a)$ to each $a\in\alpha$, with $p(a)\ge 0$ for every $a$ and $\sum_{a\in\alpha}p(a)=1$.
